proposals.evidence: Turner gives Hindi/Western Pahari gāt body, Nepali gāth person/body and Bengali gā body under gātra. The Haryanvi gāṭ, Gujari gāth and Bengali ga responses fit these regional shapes. The short responses are not assigned to the separate gātraka family with an additional suffix.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Gujarati kɔṇī, Kotgarhi kvṇi and Punjabi kūhṇī elbow, beside Prakrit kuhaṇī. The Mewari/Gujari contracted forms and Rathwi kuhuŋi fit this family; the latter’s velar nasal is a regional qualification. Both Gujari slash alternatives are vowel-length variants of the same word.
